name: General
description: The base of every Jinnee: invoice monitoring, email triage, competitor watch, weekly report.

send_customer_email.label: Send an email to a customer

void_or_edit_invoice.label: Void or edit an issued invoice

office.inbox.name: Milo: the owner's inbox
office.inbox.task: Owner's inbox triage, as in your agent file: sort what came in into needs you / draft ready, approve / handled. Customer mail goes to Echo and bills or invoices to Ledger as a handoff line, not as a reply. Every reply is a draft; what should be sent is queued for approval.

echo.customer_mail.name: Echo: customer mail
echo.customer_mail.task: Customer mail triage, as in your agent file: for each new customer message a finished reply built on real data from the connectors (order number, carrier status, invoice number), queued with core/approvals.py add as send_customer_email. A fact you cannot find is named as unknown. Returns, complaints and anything about a refund go to the lead.

ledger.invoice_watch.name: Ledger: invoice watch
ledger.invoice_watch.task: Invoice watch, as in your agent file: issued and overdue invoices from the invoicing connector; for each overdue one a reminder draft, queued for approval. Also the quota watch (say so at 80 % of the monthly invoice limit). Write the result to handoffs/ledger/<date>-invoice-watch.md, so the morning brief can use it.

ledger.weekly_finance.name: Ledger: weekly finance line
ledger.weekly_finance.task: The weekly finance line, as in your agent file: revenue, orders, average basket, invoices issued and overdue, open returns, cash on delivery not received yet. Only numbers a connector gave; a missing one is named as missing. Write it to handoffs/ledger/<date>-weekly.md for the Friday report.

watcher.weekly_round.name: Scout: weekly competitor round
watcher.weekly_round.task: The weekly round, as in your agent file: the competitors listed in brain/watch/competitors.md, compared with last week's snapshot in brain/watch/<competitor>.md (update the snapshot). Public pages only, every fact with its source and date. The 5-line summary goes to handoffs/scout/<date>-weekly-round.md for the Friday report.
